configuration.prompt: A cinematic wide-angle photograph of one enormous red suspension bridge forming a single continuous horizontal structure from the far left edge to the far right edge, crossing behind one yellow vintage train centered on the bridge; exactly one white lighthouse stands on the left shore and exactly one dark stone tower stands on the right shore, asymmetric composition, continuous bridge cables and deck, coherent perspective, sunset light
configuration.selection: floor(i * source_token_count / selected_count), independently per strip
configuration.modified_blocks: all 5 double and all 20 single blocks
configuration.overlap_policy: coarse and selected native K/V concatenated without coordinate deduplication
